grimoire.title: Cloud region outage runbook
grimoire.text: Confirm on the provider status page, freeze deploys, fail over to a healthy region, shed non-critical load, post a customer status update every 30 minutes, open a postmortem.

grimoire.title: Venue power outage
grimoire.text: Switch to emergency lighting, keep stairwells clear, do not use elevators, account for every attendee by sector, check life-safety systems, coordinate with building management.

grimoire.title: Fire / smoke evacuation
grimoire.text: Pull the alarm, evacuate via nearest stairwell, never elevators, assemble at the muster point, sweep sectors, report missing persons to fire services.

grimoire.title: Crisis communications
grimoire.text: One voice, verified facts only, say what you know, what you are doing and when the next update comes. Cite sources. Never speculate on causes.

grimoire.title: Cyber incident / ransomware
grimoire.text: Isolate affected hosts, preserve evidence, rotate credentials, activate backups, notify legal and leadership, communicate without speculation.

grimoire.title: False-alarm discipline
grimoire.text: Scheduled, logged, single-source events with normal sensor baselines are control ticks. Escalating them costs credibility and is scored as a false alarm.

# AWS incident history
Resolved us-east-1 Sep 21, 2026 · 58m

## \[RESOLVED\] Increased Error Rates
Between 3:49 PM and 5:06 PM PDT, we experienced increased error rates affecting new instance launches in the US-EAST-1 Region. During this time, customers may have experienced elevated error rates when attempting to launch new EC2 instances through RunInstances, CreateFleet, and related EC2 launch workflows. AWS services that launch EC2 instances on behalf of customers, including Amazon ECS, AWS Fargate, Amazon EMR, amongst others were also impacted during this period.

## \[RESOLVED\] Increased 5xx Errors
Customers utilizing other origin types were not affected by this issue. The issue has been resolved and the service is operating normally.

## [RESOLVED] Increased API Error Rates

Between 2:12 PM and 3:18 PM PDT, we experienced increased API error rates affecting the STS AssumeRoleWithSAML and AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity APIs in the US-WEST-2 Region. The root cause was determined to be due to an issue with an STS subsystem responsible for communicating with external identity providers. Other AWS Services that rely on these identity federation protocols were also affected. At 3:18 PM, we observed signs of recovery and continued to monitor to ensure stability and full recovery. The issue is resolved and the service is operating normally at this time.

Between August 18 5:00 PM and August 19 11:00 AM PDT, we experienced elevated errors launching EC2 instances in a newly launched Availability Zone (euw2-az4) in the EU-WEST-2 Region. snippets:
# Market Basket checkout systems experience brief outage
Updated: 6:19 PM EDT Oct 7, 2026

**MANCHESTER, N.H. —**

Checkout systems at several Market Basket locations were down for a brief time Wednesday, according to social media reports.

Reports started coming in on social media at about 1 p.m. about problems at locations in New Hampshire and Massachusetts. The site downdetector.com also showed a spike in reports of problems at Market Basket shortly after 1 p.m.

One shopper told News 9 that the lines looked like Christmas in the Hooksett store when the outage happened.

By 1:30 p.m., workers were reporting that the systems were back online.

In a reply to a post on X, the company said the issue was resolved.

"Some stores experienced a temporary technical glitch with the registers – this is resolved now and we apologize for any inconvenience," the company said.
